hub_identity.reservation_rule: Reserve the ticket (atomic O_EXCL create) before writing runners, artifacts, data, or logs. Existing IDs are rejected across registry, JSONL, tickets, logs, artifacts, data, and runners.

hypothesis: candidate_pool: PIT raw SEC Companyfacts advertising / selling-marketing expense intensity falling versus revenue, while revenue and gross profit remain healthy, can identify improving customer-acquisition efficiency; liquid SPY-relative confirmation may reveal that the market is rewarding the improvement before a 10-trading-day continuation leg.

nearest.reopen_condition: A retry needs materially different PIT gross-profitability evidence or closed forward replacement rows. Do not sweep gross-margin, gross-profit/assets, sector-percentile, fact freshness, RS/close/volume/vol guards, top-N, hold, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.

novelty.new_evidence_axis: new SEC Companyfacts customer-acquisition efficiency concept using advertising/selling-marketing expense intensity, not previously tested balance-sheet overhang, DPO, cash-conversion, SBC, inventory, or generic profitability ratios

prediction.confidence_reason: Advertising / selling-marketing intensity is a raw SEC Companyfacts customer-acquisition efficiency field, distinct from prior SG&A, SBC, inventory, DPO, cash-conversion, and generic profitability trials. The main risk is economic ambiguity: lower advertising intensity can signal better acquisition efficiency, but can also mean demand is softening or management is cutting growth spend.

execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing raw SEC annual advertising/selling-marketing expense, revenue, or gross-profit facts, missing prior comparison period, stale facts, missing CIK mapping, missing OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same raw SEC advertising / selling-marketing tag mapping, filed-date PIT ad/revenue improvement gate, liquid SPY-relative confirmation, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.

post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The advertising efficiency improvement source did not clear Gate 4 (failed: window_ev_regression, window_pnl_regression, drawdown_drift_too_high, target_concentration_failed, accepted_compression_ev_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_ev_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_pnl_not_beaten). The fixed bundle tested explicit raw SEC advertising / selling-marketing intensity improvement plus liquid SPY-relative confirmation. It is not retained or promoted.
post_run_reflection.outcome_summary: Aggregate EV delta +0.0266; aggregate PnL delta $+2,867.45; max drawdown drift +0.0098; 52 paper trades.
post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping advertising / selling-marketing tag lists, expense/revenue thresholds, gross-margin floors, annual fact freshness, RS/close/volume/vol guards, top-N, hold days, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A retry needs materially different PIT customer-acquisition efficiency evidence such as unit economics, segment-level sales productivity, new customer count, paid channel mix, or closed forward replacement rows. Do not sweep advertising tags, intensity thresholds, annual fact freshness, price guards, top-N, hold, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.
